status: DIAGNOSTIC — design-authored, unreviewed corpus; not evidence for runtime integration

cross_encoder.name: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3
cross_encoder.scores: raw logits for ranking and calibration; sigmoid only for contract confidence

selection_rules:
- Cross-encoder passage format: the format with higher development top-1 accuracy for all-30
  scoring ("scope" wins ties).
- Hybrid shortlist size k: the smallest k in 3..15 whose normalized-E5 development recall@k is at
  least 0.95 (15 if none reaches it).
- Decision policies: tools.skill_mapper_benchmark.calibration.fit_policy on development cases.
The test split is scored once per configuration and never used for any selection.

e5-head.description: frozen live policy (0.82 / 0.03 / 0.70), taxonomy passages only

e5-working-tree.description: frozen live policy (0.82 / 0.03 / 0.70), taxonomy passages only

fit.selection_rule:
(fixed before any benchmark run):
1. Keep only policies with zero false confident matches on the development cases supplied.
2. Maximize correct confirmed matches.
3. Break ties toward the most conservative policy (largest margin, then largest match score).
4. Then choose the candidate (clarification) threshold that maximizes development status
   accuracy, breaking ties toward the larger threshold.
Zero observed errors on development data is a target, not a guarantee for unseen inputs.
